metric_units.jitter_m_s3: m/s³ (mean jerk of predicted motion, no GT reference)
metric_units.foot_skate_cm_s: cm/s (weighted horizontal foot sliding while in contact)
metric_units.gpen_mean_mm: mm (mean ground penetration depth of penetrating vertices)
metric_units.gpen_max_mm: mm (worst-case ground penetration depth in sequence)
metric_units.gpen_rate: fraction of frames with any vertex below Z=0

notes: Ground penetration uses SMPL-H mesh vertices (6890) vs flat floor at Z=0 (AMASS Z-up).
Foot skate uses SMPL joints 10/11 (left/right foot), H_thresh=0.033m, fps=60.
Jitter = mean ||3rd-order finite difference of predicted joint positions|| * 60^3.
MPJRE uses geodesic distance between rotation matrices (not axis-angle MAE).
IK module present in network but NOT called during test() — known AvatarPoser quirk.
